principes.titel: Reinforce your main fight with flank or rear charges
principes.tekst: Bring support into the flank or rear of an enemy fighting your main unit. This can add combat resolution or help finish a fight your main unit cannot win alone.

principes.titel: Hide vulnerable units behind terrain to deny enemy shooting
principes.tekst: Use terrain that blocks line of sight to shelter units from damaging shooting.

principes.titel: Use threats to restrict movement without committing to combat
principes.tekst: Position threats so the opponent must avoid an area or change their moves. A unit can influence the battle without actually fighting.

principes.titel: Lower enemy Leadership before Terror, break tests and Leadership attacks
principes.tekst: Use Leadership penalties, most often from Necromancy, before you force a test or use an attack that works against Leadership. The lower value makes the enemy more likely to fail or take more damage.

principes.titel: Deploy units so their planned support can work
principes.tekst: Deploy units that need to work together in supporting positions. Plan ahead so an early advance or charge does not leave a fighting unit unsupported.

principes.titel: Guard vulnerable flanks with terrain or supporting units
principes.tekst: Use terrain, a board edge or supporting units to protect vulnerable flanks. Deny enemies routes around your army into its exposed sides or rear.

principes.titel: Screen your important units from enemy shooting
principes.tekst: Keep a screen between enemy shooters and the unit you want to protect. It can block shots, absorb fire or provide cover for the unit behind.

principes.titel: Check enemy reach before choosing safe deployment positions
principes.tekst: Check enemy movement and attack ranges so opening attacks do not catch your vulnerable units. Include Vanguard moves when judging how far forward threats can reach.

principes.titel: Prepare countercharges with units that can survive the first charge
principes.tekst: Keep a supporting attacker ready when another unit receives a charge. Use a receiver that can survive the hit so your support can countercharge.

principes.titel: Win objective contests without needing to destroy enemy units
principes.tekst: Play for the scoring position rather than finishing off every opponent. Holding your ground or moving an enemy away can secure the objective points.

principes.titel: Use bait and screens to set up your supporting charges
principes.tekst: Position bait or a screen so following it brings the enemy within reach of your waiting support. Use that support to countercharge.

principes.titel: Position for reliable charges before committing your attacker
principes.tekst: Manoeuvre into a position where your intended charge is reliable. Avoid depending on a long charge roll when you can prepare a closer attempt.

principes.titel: Weigh the first-turn bonus when choosing deployment drops
principes.tekst: If going first matters, consider fewer deployment drops or placing first to earn the first-turn bonus. Weigh that against the information you give up by placing before the enemy.

principes.titel: Use defensive challenges to contain dangerous attackers
principes.tekst: Use a champion or protected character to absorb a dangerous attacker's blows in a challenge. This can protect your unit or another valuable model in the combat.

principes.titel: Weaken dangerous enemies with shooting before your troops fight them
principes.tekst: Remove wounds or models before dangerous enemies reach combat. You can make the coming fight manageable without destroying the target at range.

principes.titel: Keep your shooters beyond enemy charge reach or arcs
principes.tekst: Keep shooting units where the enemy cannot immediately charge them. Reposition as threats close rather than leaving the shooters exposed.

principes.titel: Choose combat characters with all-round charge options
principes.tekst: Choose characters or mounts that can threaten charges in any direction. This gives you more freedom to pick targets and respond to enemies manoeuvring around you.

principes.titel: Deploy scorers to reach the objectives you plan to contest
principes.tekst: Choose reachable scoring locations and deploy your scorers with practical routes to them. Avoid making them waste turns travelling into position.

principes.titel: Use marching column to reach useful positions quickly
principes.tekst: Use marching column when you need to cover ground quickly. Its extra march distance can help you reach objectives, blocking positions or an approach for a later attack.

principes.titel: Remove enemy artillery early to protect your important units
principes.tekst: Prioritise shooting enemy artillery before it damages the units you need. Removing those guns lets your threatened units operate more freely.

principes.titel: Use ambushers to score in unattended areas
principes.tekst: Send ambushers into open space to capture or contest objectives, or attack baggage trains. Advancing enemies can leave these scoring opportunities behind them.

principes.titel: Use ranged attacks to clear enemy chaff
principes.tekst: Use ranged attacks to remove enemy chaff. They let you clear blockers or deal with mobile targets without catching them in combat.

principes.titel: With the stronger shooting army, shoot first and fight later
principes.tekst: When your ranged firepower outclasses the enemy's, weaken them from range and stay out of combat until it suits you. Some missions make this patient plan easier.

principes.titel: Use movement spells to accelerate your advance
principes.tekst: Use movement magic to push attacking units forward and reach threatening positions sooner. The extra movement helps you apply pressure.

principes.titel: Keep your expendable chaff cheap
principes.tekst: Keep the points spent on sacrificial chaff low. Its low cost makes it affordable to lose while doing its job.

principes.titel: Line up overruns into another fight
principes.tekst: Plan overrun paths that carry your attackers into another enemy unit so they can keep fighting.

principes.titel: Keep lone characters near suitable troops for targeting protection
principes.tekst: Keep lone characters near friendly units of the right troop type. Leave a friendly unit closer to the enemy to retain protection from ranged targeting.

principes.titel: Build your list to meet the tournament's mission requirements
principes.tekst: Check the tournament missions while choosing your units. Your list needs a workable plan for the requirements those missions impose.

principes.titel: Check friendly panic risks before you commit chaff
principes.tekst: Check which friendly units could test for panic if your chaff dies or flees through them. Avoid exposing your support to unnecessary tests.

principes.titel: Use cheap early drops to delay your key units
principes.tekst: Deploy expendable units first and retain options for your important units. Choose their positions after seeing where the opponent commits.

principes.titel: Cast from outside the enemy wizard's dispel range
principes.tekst: Cast from outside the opposing wizard's dispel range when you can. A flying or Reserve Move caster can move out, cast and move back to safety.

principes.titel: Concentrate ranged attacks to finish targets
principes.tekst: Focus your ranged damage on a chosen target rather than spreading it across several. Combine attacks to remove the target instead of leaving it alive with wounds remaining.

principes.titel: Use expendable units to buy time for wins elsewhere
principes.tekst: Use expendable units to delay enemy threats while your main force works elsewhere. A sacrifice can succeed by buying time even when it earns few kills.

principes.titel: Secure key spells instead of relying on random generation
principes.tekst: Use useful signature spells or spell-selection options to secure the spells your plan needs. Random generation can leave your wizard without the spells you wanted.

principes.titel: Use challenges to help infantry hold against dragons
principes.tekst: Let a challenger face the dragon while your infantry contributes combat resolution. Limiting casualties helps the block hold or win the fight.

principes.titel: Hold the centre, win a flank, then turn on the centre
principes.tekst: Hold the centre with a durable anvil and put your faster units on the flanks. Once a flank is won, turn those units into the centre or the enemy backline.

principes.titel: Set up your hammers to deliver their own charges
principes.tekst: Plan your hammers' movement and support so they get the charge. Chariots particularly need to connect with their impact hits rather than receive a charge.

principes.titel: Use skirmishing formations to reduce incoming shooting hits
principes.tekst: When a unit or a wizard's bunker needs protection from shooting, consider a skirmishing formation. Its penalty to be hit makes the unit harder to shoot.

principes.titel: Start scoring accessible progressive objectives early
principes.tekst: Get scorers onto accessible objectives early when they award points throughout the game. Those scoring turns can build a lead while the opponent delays.

principes.titel: Add characters to give basic units more combat punch
principes.tekst: Use fighting characters or character buffs to improve a basic unit's damage output. The extra attacks can make otherwise modest troops more threatening.

principes.titel: Keep valuable units out of matchups they are likely to lose
principes.tekst: Keep a valuable unit away from an enemy likely to defeat it. Withdraw or seek a safer engagement instead of forcing the fight.

principes.titel: Build infantry blocks to win through static combat resolution
principes.tekst: Use ranks and banners to raise your infantry's combat result. This helps you win fights without relying entirely on inflicted wounds.

principes.titel: Concentrate your strength against part of the enemy army
principes.tekst: Bring your main strength against only part of the opposing army. Create a local advantage while other enemy units are distant, delayed or unsupported.

principes.titel: Give your infantry Death Star a large wound pool
principes.tekst: Take enough bodies and wounds for your Death Star to absorb casualties and keep fighting.

principes.titel: Deny flyers landing space around your valuable units
principes.tekst: Fill the gaps enemy flyers need to land near your valuable units. In particular, block space behind your line before they fly over it.

principes.titel: Use character threats to deter enemy dragons from approaching
principes.tekst: Position a character to make an enemy dragon's approach risky. The threat can protect space without committing your character to combat.

principes.titel: Keep vulnerable support characters out of direct melee contact
principes.tekst: Place support characters outside the fight or in unit positions that avoid enemy contact. This lets them contribute without taking unnecessary attacks.

principes.titel: Lower Leadership before your screams and Terror charges
principes.tekst: Pair Necromancy's Leadership penalties with Tomb Banshee screams and Terror. A lower target Leadership makes those attacks more dangerous.

principes.titel: Reform victorious units towards their next useful fight
principes.tekst: Consider restraining and reforming after a win to threaten another useful combat. Choose a facing that keeps your combat unit involved in the battle.

principes.titel: Use cheap units to hold objectives and scoring areas
principes.tekst: Assign inexpensive units to objective-holding and area-scoring jobs.

principes.titel: Use movement spells to get characters out of danger
principes.tekst: Use magical movement to rescue a threatened character or give it the mobility to withdraw after using its abilities.

principes.titel: Use Reserve Move magic to advance threats and apply pressure
principes.tekst: Use magic granting Reserve Move to move your threats farther forward. The extra movement helps you reach positions that put pressure on the enemy.

principes.titel: Aim cannon shots through multiple models
principes.tekst: Look for firing lines that let a cannonball pass through several models, increasing the casualties a shot can cause.

principes.titel: Give your units and characters defined battlefield jobs
principes.tekst: Decide what each unit, character or small group should accomplish. Judge your choices by how well they perform those jobs for your army.

principes.titel: Block useful enemy ambush entry space during deployment
principes.tekst: Position your units to deny useful arrival gaps along the board edge. Their presence restricts where enemy ambushers can enter.

principes.titel: Counter enemy dragons with a dragon of your own
principes.tekst: Consider your own dragon as an answer to an opposing dragon. The prospect of fighting yours can make the enemy's attacks less attractive.

principes.titel: Push threats forward to draw fire away from key units
principes.tekst: Present a threat the opponent must deal with, drawing shooting away from your main units. This gives those units time to advance or do their jobs.

principes.titel: Use movement spells to escape enemy charge arcs
principes.tekst: Reposition threatened units outside enemy charge arcs with movement magic. This can prevent the opponent from charging them next turn.

principes.titel: Guard artillery approaches with supporting units
principes.tekst: Put supporting units in the path of approaching artillery hunters. Make those hunters deal with the defenders before they can reach your guns.

principes.titel: Plan which units will hold the objectives at the end
principes.tekst: Work out early how your units will reach the objectives in the last turns, and keep them alive until then. Refuse fights that do not serve that plan.

principes.titel: Keep mobile scorers safe for later scoring
principes.tekst: Protect some mobile scoring units during the opening turns, then use them to claim objectives later.

principes.titel: Protect defensive units with Earthen Ramparts
principes.tekst: Cast Earthen Ramparts on units holding a defensive position. Its ward save helps them withstand incoming attacks.

principes.titel: Reach combat early to cut a gunline's shooting time
principes.tekst: Move quickly into combat against shooting armies. Early engagement limits how long their shooting can damage your units.

principes.titel: Use several low-level casters to repeat useful signature spells
principes.tekst: Consider multiple low-level wizards carrying the same useful signature spell. This gives you repeated casting attempts without requiring high-level casters.

principes.titel: Reposition great-bow Ushabti without losing shooting accuracy
principes.tekst: Move or turn your Ushabti when needed to keep targets in their firing arc. Their shooting does not suffer penalties for this movement.

principes.titel: Shoot multi-wound targets with great-bow Ushabti
principes.tekst: Use your great-bow Ushabti against multi-wound targets. Their shots deal two damage, but account for their low armour piercing when choosing targets.

principes.titel: Threaten monsters with Monster Slayer characters
principes.tekst: Consider a character with Monster Slayer to threaten enemy monsters. A flying mount helps you position that threat.

principes.titel: Use Power Scrolls for crucial casts
principes.tekst: Use a Power Scroll when getting a particular spell through is crucial to your plan. It improves your chance of getting the effect when you need it.

principes.titel: Use terrain to shorten enemy charges and buy time
principes.tekst: Position around woods or spell-created terrain that forces shorter charge rolls. Delaying the enemy can buy another turn of shooting or movement.

principes.titel: Keep enemy overruns and redirects away from your valuable units
principes.tekst: Place chaff, screens and supporting units so an enemy that wins, overruns or redirects cannot carry on into a valuable unit. Check the attacker's facing and path before you settle those positions.

principes.titel: Against Cathay, use multiple-wound attacks against Sky Lanterns
principes.tekst: Use attacks that inflict multiple wounds to bring down Sky Lanterns.

principes.titel: Use dangerous decoys to divert resources from your main force
principes.tekst: Offer a threat your opponent cannot safely ignore. Dealing with it uses shots or units that could otherwise threaten your main force.

principes.titel: Keep threatened units outside enemy charge reach
principes.tekst: Measure where enemy units can charge before choosing your moves. Move threatened units outside their reach or charge arcs to keep them safe.

principes.titel: Choose hammers that can survive shooting on the way in
principes.tekst: Your opponent will try to kill your hammers before they strike. Pick ones durable enough to survive the shooting and still reach combat.

principes.titel: Choose mobile chaff that can reach its blocking position
principes.tekst: Choose chaff with enough movement to get ahead of the enemy. Its mobility lets you place a blocker where it can obstruct the enemy's advance.

principes.titel: Delay enemies to buy time for your attacks
principes.tekst: Use movement or control to make enemies take longer to reach you. This gives you more time for shooting and favourable attacks.

principes.titel: Delay key placements until relevant enemy units are committed
principes.tekst: Where possible, let your opponent place the relevant pieces first. Use that information to choose your own positions and favourable matchups.

principes.titel: Keep your challenger able to reach the threatened fighting rank
principes.tekst: Check that your intended challenger is in, or can enter, the rank facing the expected charge. Champions cannot move through the ranks to reach a flank attacker.

principes.titel: Reinforce ongoing fights with supporting charges
principes.tekst: Bring a supporting unit into an existing fight to add damage or combat resolution. This can help your main unit break through instead of grinding alone.

principes.titel: Use unpredictable random movement to restrict enemy positioning
principes.tekst: Use random movers' uncertain reach to threaten nearby ground. Their potential movement can make opponents hold back or change their positioning without you making contact.

principes.titel: Stack shooting hit penalties to protect your units
principes.tekst: Combine multiple shooting hit penalties on a unit. Making incoming shooting less accurate reduces the damage it takes.

principes.titel: Use supported charges to dislodge objective defenders
principes.tekst: Coordinate attackers and supporting units when charging to push a defender off an objective.

principes.titel: Use suitable ambushers to hunt enemy war machines
principes.tekst: Give suitable ambushing units the job of attacking and destroying enemy war machines.

principes.titel: Give smaller or vulnerable scorers the safer scoring positions
principes.tekst: Put smaller or more vulnerable scorers in safer positions. Keep larger units available for objectives the opponent will contest.

principes.titel: Against Bretonnia, use low-Strength shooting to avoid the stronger Blessing
principes.tekst: Use low-Strength shooting against knights to avoid improving their ward save. Against Pegasus Knights, look for high armour piercing as well.

principes.titel: Against Cathay, send cannon hunters that can handle Ogre crews
principes.tekst: Bring enough combat power or bodies to handle the Ogre crew when hunting Cathayan cannons. Undersized hunting units can be defeated before doing their job.

principes.titel: Choose shooting ambushers for an immediate arrival volley
principes.tekst: Use shooting ambushers to attack a vulnerable target on the turn they arrive. Move into a useful firing position instead of waiting for a later charge to contribute.

principes.titel: Use combined charges when one attacker lacks the damage
principes.tekst: Send several attackers into the same target in the same turn. Their combined damage gives you a better chance of beating it.

principes.titel: Concentrate your shooting on one target
principes.tekst: Focus your shots on one enemy target to improve your chances of removing it.

principes.titel: Damage enemy scorers to deny their objective points
principes.tekst: Focus damage on enemy scoring units to stop them earning objective points.

principes.titel: Delay objective commitment when you need time to prepare
principes.tekst: Consider delaying your commitment to an objective so you can prepare your position before contesting it.

principes.titel: Let another unit chase fugitives while your main unit stays useful
principes.tekst: Use another unit to chase fleeing enemies rather than sending your main combat unit after them. After a shared victory, you can let one attacker pursue while the other restrains and reforms.

principes.titel: Use Evasive to retreat beyond shooting range or sight
principes.tekst: Position your Evasive unit so its retreat can take it outside the shooter's range or line of sight. This can deny the incoming shot.

principes.titel: Keep supporting units out of unwanted overrun paths
principes.tekst: Separate, stagger or offset nearby units so an enemy charging one cannot overrun straight into another. Set this spacing during deployment.

principes.titel: Place control spells across the enemy's intended route
principes.tekst: Place obstructing or dangerous spells where enemy units intend to move. This disrupts their approach or makes the route more dangerous.

principes.titel: Protect vulnerable scorers with cover or screens
principes.tekst: Use terrain or screening units to protect your scorers as you position them for objectives. Avoid exposing them to shooting just to reach or hold a scoring position.

principes.titel: Save limited dispelling tools for critical moments
principes.tekst: Keep limited dispelling tools available for the spells that can derail your plan. Choose when to spend them according to the spell's importance at that moment.

principes.titel: Screen frenzied units until you want them to charge
principes.tekst: Keep a screen in front of frenzied troops to block unwanted charges. Advance them into position before clearing the screen for your chosen charge.

principes.titel: Screen your hammers with chaff while setting up favourable charges
principes.tekst: Use chaff or skirmishing screens to protect your hammers while you arrange their attacks. The screen helps your hammer reach the fight you want.

principes.titel: Soften targets before your finishing cavalry charge
principes.tekst: Use shooting or an earlier cavalry attack to weaken the target. This gives your finishing cavalry a better chance of breaking through.

principes.titel: Support demanding spells with extra casting bonuses
principes.tekst: When investing in magic, seek casting bonuses beyond wizard level. High casting values can make important spells hard to rely on.

principes.titel: Keep a BSB near combats you need to hold
principes.tekst: Keep your BSB in support range when holding a combat matters. Its reroll reduces the risk of a crucial failed break test.

principes.titel: Against Cathay, aim Doom Divers at its big threats and artillery
principes.tekst: Doom Divers can soften the Shugengan Lord before your Wyvern goes in, or thin out Cathay's artillery before its opening volley.

principes.titel: Use Evasive to retreat when targeted by shooting
principes.tekst: When an enemy targets you with shooting, use Evasive to move away. Your retreat can reduce the effectiveness of that shooting.

principes.titel: Use mobile Wolf Riders to capture objectives
principes.tekst: March Wolf Riders onto objectives or bring them in from ambush. Their mobility helps you reach scoring positions.

principes.titel: Use mobility to avoid enemy charges
principes.tekst: Move clear of advancing enemies to keep your units from being caught in combat.

principes.titel: Use movement magic to reach Fanatic launch positions
principes.tekst: Use movement spells to reposition Night Goblin carriers before releasing their Fanatics. The extra reach helps you reach targets or useful launch angles.

principes.titel: Use Skinks as screeners
principes.tekst: Use Skink Skirmishers or Chameleon Skinks to screen your army. These screeners can also contribute shooting.

principes.titel: Use Spellbreaking against casts your normal dispelling struggles to stop
principes.tekst: Use Runes of Spellbreaking when strong enemy casting makes normal dispelling unreliable.
